subLocations.name: Calantar's Way
subLocations.lore: The road that started at the [[Eastgate (Suzail|Eastgate]] and went north past [[Calantar's Bridge]] and towards [[Arabel]].

subLocations.name: Way of the Dragon
subLocations.lore: The road that started at the [[Horngate]], cut through the [[King's Forest]] and reached the town of [[Waymoot]].

subLocations.name: The Promenade
subLocations.lore: Once known as '''The March''', the wide and semi-circular street arching the [[Royal Court]] district. It was one of the best shopping strolls on [[Toril]].

subLocations.name: Garth Street
subLocations.lore: The street that stretched from the [[Market (Suzail)|Market]] to the [[Promenade (Suzail) |Promenade]].

subLocations.name: Hunt Bide
subLocations.lore: The street that stretched from [[the Basin]] to the [[Promenade (Suzail)|Promenade]].

subLocations.name: Tholone Lane
subLocations.lore: A short arc street between [[Nerester's Run]] and [[Silverscales Street]].

subLocations.name: Nerester's Run
subLocations.lore: The street at the western end of [[Tholone Lane]].

subLocations.name: Silverscales Street
subLocations.lore: The street at the eastern end of [[Tholone Lane]].

subLocations.name: Swordstars Lane
subLocations.lore: The street that ended in a "Y" junction to the north and a "T" junction to the south.

subLocations.name: Cart alley
subLocations.lore: A busy cart alley for the warehouses on the block that connected to [[Swordstars Lane]].

subLocations.name: Royal Ride
subLocations.lore: A rich street that began on the [[Promenade (Suzail)|Promenade]] by the [[Towers of Good Fortune]] and ran west.

subLocations.name: Stonebow Street
subLocations.lore: A street that began on the [[Promenade (Suzail)|Promenade]] and housed the [[Shrine to Lliira (Suzail)|Shrine to Lliira]] on its northern side.

subLocations.name: Torch Street
subLocations.lore: A street that crossed [[Stonebow Street]], west of the [[Shrine to Lliira (Suzail)|Shrine to Lliira]].

subLocations.name: Blade Lane
subLocations.lore: A curved street at the eastern end of [[Stonebow Street]].

subLocations.name: Coachwheels Way
subLocations.lore: A straight street with the Shrine to Milil on its west side.

subLocations.name: Dancing Druid Lane
subLocations.lore: The street with the entrance to The [[Osculatory]] at its northern end.

subLocations.name: Street of Staves
subLocations.lore: The street that met with the [[Promenade (Suzail)|Promenade]] right by the [[Dragon's Jaws]] tavern.

subLocations.name: Court Close
subLocations.lore: The street that passed immediately east of The [[Winking Eye]], looped around the next block and ran all the way to [[Bolliver's Wharf]].

subLocations.name: Court Close
subLocations.lore: The street that passed immediately east of The [[Winking Eye]], looped around the next block and ran all the way to [[Bolliver's Wharf]].

subLocations.name: Court Close
subLocations.lore: The street that passed immediately east of The [[Winking Eye]], looped around the next block and ran all the way to [[Bolliver's Wharf]].

subLocations.name: Court Close
subLocations.lore: The street that passed immediately east of The [[Winking Eye]], looped around the next block and ran all the way to [[Bolliver's Wharf]].

subLocations.name: Mayhap Lane
subLocations.lore: The street that crossed with [[Hunt Bide]] and the [[Promenade (Suzail)|Promenade]] on the corner where The [[The Six Candles|Six Candles]] stood.

subLocations.name: Stables of the Six Candles inn
subLocations.lore: Located in the middle of the block with its entry on [[Windever Street]].

subLocations.name: Windever Street
subLocations.lore: The street ending at the [[Promenade (Suzail)|Promenade]] with the entry to the stables of the [[The Six Candles|Six Candles]] inn.

subLocations.name: Doloph Street
subLocations.lore: A short street that began at a crossing with [[Mayhap Lane]] in the north and ended at [[Garth Street]] in the south.

subLocations.name: Minstrel's Ride
subLocations.lore: A street that crossed [[Nerester's Run]] and ended at the [[Court Close]].

subLocations.name: Dunstan's Way
subLocations.lore: A short street that began across the way from where the [[Hunt Bide]] began and ended on a moot with [[Nerester's Run]] and [[Silverscales Street]].
